name: Amazon Q Developer
tagline: Amazon Q Developer is AWS's AI coding assistant, built into the AWS Console, VS Code, and JetBrains IDEs. It generates code, explains AWS services, writes infrastructure-as-code, and helps debug issues — with specialised training on AWS documentation and best practices. Teams building on AWS use it to accelerate development and reduce the time spent navigating complex cloud APIs.
